title: .respawnpack/push.consumed — the consumed push authorization (JSON, despite the extension)
description: Written by hooks/push-guard.js. GITIGNORED, and inside the CONTROL PLANE no subagent may write (a permission boundary whose configuration lives in the space it governs is not a boundary — finding N-9, and G4-P0-2 where this exact filename matched no control-plane pattern). ⛔ TWO FIELDS ENCODE TWO FIXED DEFECTS: `session`, because the guard once compared only command and elapsed time, so an identical push from ANY session rode another session's go-ahead; and `firstAt`, because each honoured retry rewrote `at` and the window slid indefinitely.

firstAt.description: The ORIGINAL consume. Readers accept `firstAt ?? at` so a pre-firstAt record still works; a record with no `session` is deliberately NOT accepted, because a retry now requires a real session id on both sides.
